responsibility: Render the real-time background task status panel: active task list with determinate progress, pause/cancel per task, empty auto-hide, and load error recovery (US-SYS-001)

inputs.tasks: TaskProgress[] mapped to UI models (taskId, taskType, lastProcessedIndex, totalCount)
inputs.taskStatus: Per-task runtime status: running / paused / cancelled

outputs.visibleContent: Task rows with SF Symbol icon, task name, determinate ProgressView, processed/total count, status label
outputs.accessibilityTree: Each task row combined with type/name/progress/status; progress as accessibility value

systemContainer: Sheet (.medium detent, draggable to .large) or iPad sidebar 320pt
fallbackConditions: No active tasks → auto-hide after 1.5s delay (US-SYS-001 AC-5)
Load failure → error state with retry (L2)
